post.hook: Anthropic's AI is now building its AI
post.subhook: Plus offshore GPUs, cuffless blood pressure, open-model cyber risk

stories.headline: METR: Anthropic uses AI to speed up AI development
stories.detail: A METR report finds Anthropic is using AI to accelerate its own AI work, with models improving about twice as fast.

stories.headline: Moonshot AI eyed European lease for 8,000+ Blackwell GPUs
stories.detail: With US curbs on China in place, the Chinese lab discussed reaching frontier compute through a European capacity lease.

stories.headline: Claude wrote about 90% of Claude Code's code
stories.detail: Anthropic also disclosed the six-layer review system it uses to check that AI-written output.

stories.headline: Google AI spots high blood pressure from a standard smartwatch
stories.detail: No cuff needed. It is live in the Google Health app now as a screening tool, not a replacement for diagnosis.

stories.headline: Open models close in on closed models in cyber capability
stories.detail: Open-weight models now come near closed frontier models on attack tasks, shrinking the window defenders have.

stories.headline: Alibaba's Qoder makes its Qoduck coding model free
stories.detail: Developers can now try the coding model at no cost.

stories.headline: Anthropic says it blocked potential bioweapon misuse
stories.detail: The company describes a safety intervention against potential misuse of its AI for bioweapons.

stories.headline: Claude can link bank accounts and analyze transactions
stories.detail: It will not give investment advice, but users who connect accounts give it access to sensitive financial data.

stories.headline: Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights reportedly due Nov. 4
stories.detail: If the release happens, practitioners could run the model themselves.

post.caption:
AI is increasingly being used to build AI, and today's news shows it from two angles.

LEADS
1. A METR report finds Anthropic is using AI to accelerate AI development, with models improving about twice as fast. (The Verge)
2. Moonshot AI discussed a European capacity lease for more than 8,000 Blackwell GPUs amid US curbs on China. (CNBC)
3. Anthropic says Claude wrote about 90% of Claude Code's code and disclosed a six-layer review system for that output. (BigGo Finance)
4. Google AI detects high blood pressure from a standard smartwatch without a cuff. It's live in the Google Health app as screening, not diagnosis. (The Decoder)
5. The gap between open and closed models in cyber capabilities keeps shrinking, with open-weight models near closed frontier models on attack tasks. (The Decoder)

BRIEFS
6. Alibaba's Qoder offers its Qoduck coding model for free. (Startup Fortune)
7. Anthropic says it blocked potential AI bioweapon misuse. (ABC News)
8. Claude can link bank accounts and analyze transactions, but won't offer investment advice. (Yahoo Finance)
9. Kimi K3.1 Pro open weights are reportedly due Nov. 4. (NeoTeo)

The tools are speeding up, and so is the scrutiny. 🔍
